title: Add short root-cause default within the reader token budget
summary: Add the 'root-cause' entry to defaults.toml (source: BRIEF.md "2026-10-13: Root causes") in one or two compact sentences. Keep its meaning: fix the origin, report out-of-scope causes, name the cause in the description, and tie it to 'small'. If the reader set still exceeds 1800 tokens, tighten wording in the reader's always-loaded text and leave the budget alone.

defaults_applied.how: One focused change: one short default, plus only the wording trims needed to fit the budget.
cargo test, clippy, and fmt must pass.
The token budget test enforces the limit; the budget stays fixed.
The entry cites its BRIEF.md addendum as source.

assumptions: The failed job's change is not in this checkout, so the entry is re-added from scratch.
The ~169 token overage is mostly the long entry; a short entry plus light trimming of the reader frame should fit.
The defaults.toml version stays 1 unless a test requires a bump.

acceptance_criteria.text: defaults.toml has a [[default]] with id "root-cause", source "BRIEF.md 2026-10-13: Root causes", and applies_to ["*"] or a justified list.

The statement covers: fix where the fault originates, not the symptom or one instance; name an out-of-scope cause and propose the fix rather than working around it; the fix's description names the root cause and why the change addresses it.
The statement says how it relates to 'small': the root-cause fix is the one focused change, and an out-of-scope cause is reported, not fixed.
The entry is short (about 400 bytes of statement or less). BRIEF.md and the budget constants are unchanged.
Run `cargo test --locked`: every test passes, including budgets::every_role_set_is_within_its_budget (reader set at or under 1800 tokens).
Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.

out_of_scope: Changing the budget estimator or tests
